title: n-homogeneity of f·Hⁿ for a dilation-invariant density f
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, H^n = μHE[n] on ℝ^P, f : ℝ^P → [0, ∞] an arbitrary function (no measurability assumed), and λ > 0 with f(λx) = f(x) for every x ∈ ℝ^P. Let ν := H^n.withDensity f. Then for every Borel A ⊆ ℝ^P, ν(λA) = λ^n·ν(A), where λA = (x ↦ λx)(A) is the image of A; in [0, ∞] this reads ν(λA) = ofReal(λ^n)·ν(A).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → (∀ x : Euclid P, f (lam • x) = f x) → ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)).withDensity f ((fun x => lam • x) '' A) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ n) * (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)).withDensity f A
